newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lihir says project reports misleading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lihir says project reports misleading.

text.p: Lihir Gold Ltd said on Tuesday recent newspaper reports suggesting that start-up details for the Lihir gold mine project in Papua New Guinea had been improved are speculative and potentially misleading.

Lihir said its board had reported in detail the timing, scale and prospects for expansion of the project in its 1995 prospectus. "Where subsequent developments have justified revision of the information communicated in the prospectus, as with the commencement of processing of oxide ore in May 1997 and the bringing forward of gold production from sulphide ore to late 1997, these have been fully reported," it said.

"Shareholders and investors should be aware that the comments by others ... which convey parameters for the Lihir project beyond the statements made by Lihir Gold Ltd are speculative and potentially misleading."
The Australian newspaper reported on Monday that an expansion of the start-up rate at the Papua New Guinea mine from 580,000 ounces a year to 900,000 ounces a year was being considered.
